audience: email marketers who manage subscriber lists and broadcast reports in AWeber

useCases.title: Map accounts, lists and custom fields
useCases.text: List the accounts this connection can reach, then the lists of one account with their subscriber counts. Read the custom fields and tags of a list.

useCases.title: Check whether an address is subscribed
useCases.text: Find a subscriber on a list by exact email, status or subscribe date. Open the subscriber to read its status, dates and tags.

useCases.title: Review broadcasts and follow-up campaigns
useCases.text: List the broadcasts of a list by status: draft, scheduled or sent. List the follow-up and broadcast campaigns too. These reads send nothing.

useCases.title: Add one subscriber who asked to join
useCases.text: Add one address to a list. Add only a person who asked to join that list, because AWeber forbids bought, shared or scraped lists.

useCases.title: Tag, edit or unsubscribe one subscriber
useCases.text: Update one subscriber, found by email. Change the name or notes, add or remove tags, set custom fields, or set the status to unsubscribed.
